c74object.name: evi.cross~
c74object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP cross~ filter as Likwitz-Riley
c74object.description:
evi.cross~ is a 'max define' for the evi_cross.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.cross~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
evi.cross~ differs from MSP cross~ in the following ways: evi.cross~ is a steeper 4-pole crossover slope (cross~ is a 3-pole slope), because 3rd order is not possible with flat summing Linkwitz-Riley. evi.cross~ is a Linkwitz-Riley crossover which sums perfectly flat (whereas cross~ is pure Butterworths and sums with a +3dB bump). evi.cross~ remains stable under modulation. For a shallower 2-pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover @see evi.crossover~.

inlet.description: The frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's lowpass and highpass outputs.
